title: mycourse.work course (courses/<course-id>/course.json)
description: A course lists module ids in learner order. The platform reads these fields in the edge router (normalizeCourseJsonToBlueprint) and in sync-to-r2. Unknown fields are allowed but ignored; validate_course.py warns about them. Rules a schema cannot express (id must equal the folder name, modules must exist, welcomePath must exist) are in RULES.md.

id.description: Must equal the course folder name. Kebab-case recommended. Never change after publishing.

description.description: Shown on the course card. Recommended.

welcomePath.description: Markdown file relative to the course folder. Shown as a Welcome lesson before module 1.

modules.description: Module ids (folder names under modules/), in learner order.

quizPassingThreshold.description: Pass mark for every quiz in the course, in percent. Default 80. This is the only pass mark the platform reads.

contentUnitLabel.description: Learner-facing name for a lesson, e.g. "session".
